description: The Journal of Statistical Software's class jss.cls v3.6 (2026/04/28) by Achim Zeileis, with jss.bst and jsslogo.jpg, from jss-style.zip on www.jstatsoft.org (public/journals/1/jss-style.zip, the journal's style files). Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror; no licence in the zip (kept private). article is the default article type (the other types are codesnippet, bookreview and softwarereview, l.37-44). The class loads article [11pt,a4paper,twoside], graphicx, xcolor, fancyvrb, [T1]{fontenc}, upquote, lmodern and hyperref (l.52-57, l.254), and prints the title block itself at begindocument/end (l.471), after which \maketitle does nothing (l.325), so \title and \author must be set in the preamble. \Plainauthor, \Address and the other title-block fields have placeholder defaults (l.121-141). The zip's README calls it pdfLaTeX infrastructure; under XeTeX its [T1]{fontenc}, loaded before General's fontspec, is overridden by fontspec's TU Latin Modern.
